say:1:1320632001:0.text: Regrettably, Callan's soul has reached its limit. Despite his resistance, he cannot defy the laws of nature with sheer willpower.
say:1:1320632001:0.source_cn: ……我不想这么说，但铐兰的灵魂快到极限了。不管他如何抗...

say:2:1320632002:0.text: His soul is weakening rapidly. If left alone, his essence would dissipate within a few days or possibly even hours.
say:2:1320632002:0.source_cn: 他的残魂无法坚持下去了。如果放任自流，铐兰的灵魂会在几...

say:3:1320632003:1.text: How could this happen?! We did our best and found his body! He just needs to return to it!
say:3:1320632003:1.source_cn: 怎么会这样！我们都已经努力找到了他的遗骸，只要他愿意回...

say:4:1320632004:1.text: His original body cannot stay with Carolina.
say:4:1320632004:1.source_cn: 那样的身体，无法陪伴卡列琳娜。

say:5:1320632005:1.text: I do not want my brother to suffer because of me anymore. I wish for him to find peace.
say:5:1320632005:1.source_cn: 我已经不需要哥哥再为我受苦了，我希望他能获得宁静！

choice_prompt:6:1320632005.text: I do not want my brother to suffer because of me anymore. I wish for him to find peace.
choice_prompt:6:1320632005.source_cn: 我已经不需要哥哥再为我受苦了，我希望他能获得宁静！

say:7:1320632006:1.text: Repairing his soul could be an option, but I'm not sure if it's possible.
say:7:1320632006:1.source_cn: 修复他的灵魂……？我不确定。
say:7:1320632006:1.male: Repairing his soul could be an option, but I'm not sure if it's possible.
say:7:1320632006:1.female: Repairing his soul could be an option, but I'm not sure if it's possible.

say:8:1320632007:1.text: Callan's soul was transferred to the golem too quickly, causing it to tear apart. It's possible that fragments of his essence still linger in his original body.
say:8:1320632007:1.source_cn: 铐兰的灵魂在被转移到机械人偶上时太过匆忙，被残暴地撕碎...

say:9:1320632008:1.text: If we could transfer these remaining fragments to the golem, he may be able to hold on longer...
say:9:1320632008:1.source_cn: 如果能把那部分灵魂也转移进人偶中，他或许能再坚持一段时间……

say:10:1320632009:1.text: Would my brother still be in pain?
say:10:1320632009:1.source_cn: 那样的哥哥，还会感到痛苦吗？

say:11:1320632010:1.text: The agony of a sundered soul will never truly fade. Yet, I believe he will find some relief.
say:11:1320632010:1.source_cn: 灵魂被撕裂的痛苦永远无法消退。但我想，他会好过一些。

say:12:1320632011:1.text: In that case, I must decline. I can't bear to see my brother endure any more pain.
say:12:1320632011:1.source_cn: 那么，请允许我拒绝。我不要哥哥再承受任何痛苦了。

say:14:1320632013:1.text: Callan! Is he trying to say something? I can't hear him clearly...
say:14:1320632013:1.source_cn: ……哥哥！他是想说什么吗？但是我什么也听不清……

say:16:1320632014:1.text: That's mechanical language. He says he still wants to stay by your side.
say:16:1320632014:1.source_cn: 那是机械的语言，他还是想留在你身边。

say:18:1320632015:1.text: I think this all depends on Callan's own wishes.
say:18:1320632015:1.source_cn: ……我想，这要取决于铐兰自己的意愿。

say:19:1320632016:1.text: Callan, do you still want to continue despite everything? Father and mother are gone, and even Rigel has passed on.
say:19:1320632016:1.source_cn: 哥哥，即便这样，你也想要坚持下去吗……？父亲和母亲大人...

narration:20:1320632017:1.text: Carolina leans her head against the motionless golem, listening quietly as Hugin tries to convey what Callan is saying.

narration:21:1320632018:1.text: After a long time, Carolina rises with tears frozen on her face.

say:22:1320632019:1.text: My lord, my brother has decided... He wishes to stay in this body.
say:22:1320632019:1.source_cn: 子爵先生，哥哥他……决定了。他不想离开。

say:24:1320632021:1.text: *Sigh*... Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, please aid in activating the spell.
say:24:1320632021:1.male: *Sigh*... Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, please aid in activating the spell.
say:24:1320632021:1.female: *Sigh*... Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, please aid in activating the spell.

say:25:1320632022:1.text: This time, everything will be in reverse. I'll transfer the fragments of the soul from the remains to that of the golem.
say:25:1320632022:1.source_cn: 这次是逆向操作，我会把铐兰遗骸中的灵魂碎片放入现在的机...
say:25:1320632022:1.male: This time, everything will be in reverse. I'll transfer the fragments of the soul from the remains to that of the golem.
say:25:1320632022:1.female: This time, everything will be in reverse. I'll transfer the fragments of the soul from the remains to that of the golem.

say:26:1320632023:1.text: I hope that this can give him some peace...
say:26:1320632023:1.source_cn: 希望或多或少，能让他获得些许安宁……

choice:6:0:1.text: Can we somehow repair his soul?
choice:6:0:1.source_cn: 如果想办法修复他的灵魂呢？
choice:6:0:1.male: Can we somehow repair his soul?
choice:6:0:1.female: Can we somehow repair his soul?

choice:6:1:2.text: Lord Ludovic, please find a way!
choice:6:1:2.source_cn: 你是柳博米尔·瓦勒沙，想想办法！
choice:6:1:2.male: Lord Ludovic, please find a way!
choice:6:1:2.female: Lord Ludovic, please find a way!
